Cell Injury

DDS Year 2 · Interactive revision module · Dr. Sudha Arumugam, Department of Pathology

Progress: 0%

Learning outcomes

By the end of this module you should be able to:

  • Define cell injury and list its causes
  • Explain the main mechanisms of cell injury, including free radicals
  • Describe the morphology of reversible and irreversible injury
  • Classify necrosis and give examples, including oral examples
  • Describe the causes, pathways and morphology of apoptosis
  • Differentiate necrosis from apoptosis
  • Outline the newer pathways of regulated cell death

How to use this module

1 · Study Notes

13 short sections with images, dental cases and reveal questions. Tick each section when done.

2 · Image Spotter

Identify gross and microscopic images – reversible change, necrosis or apoptosis?

3 · Flashcards

Tap to flip. Mark the ones you know and re-study the rest.

4 · MCQ Quiz

Single-best-answer questions with explanations and a score by topic.
